doc: Unified registry of Emi's own accounts across platforms. Handles come from EMI_OWN_* env vars at read time (kept out of git); auth tokens live in either the OAuth registry (configs/oauth_accounts.json) for Google or auth.* pods for everything else. Subsystems (subconscious, send_email, future bluesky_post / x_post / reddit_post tools) read this resource to know 'which identity am I acting as on platform X.' The /emi-accounts admin UI uses auth.env_ref + auth.secret_label to drive its configure-modal — each pod_ref account declares which env var the raw secret lives in and what to call it in the UI prompt.

accounts.notes: Shares the same Google Cloud project + OAuth client as Jukka's account (Emi is approved as a test user under that project). Complete consent at /oauth/google/start?account_id=emi_google_primary signing in as openpodbayemi@gmail.com. send_email now supports from_account='emi' end-to-end.

auth.secret_hint: Generate at Bluesky Settings → Privacy and Security → App Passwords. Looks like abcd-efgh-ijkl-mnop.

accounts.notes: AT Protocol. App password stashed in auth.bearer pod (env_ref EMI_POD_BLUESKY_APP_PASSWORD). Wired end-to-end via http_request + skills/bluesky/SKILL.md — two-step createSession then Bearer for any operation.

auth.secret_hint: Generate at developer.x.com under your project's app keys. Paid tier required for write.

accounts.notes: Paid API tier required for write. Defer until Bluesky proves the participation loop.

auth.secret_hint: Create a script-type app at reddit.com/prefs/apps; use the OAuth token, not the secret.

accounts.notes: OAuth app + per-subreddit posting rules. Read-only browsing first; participation only after voice/persona resource is solid.
